title: outline
description: research/outline.json (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 104): what the owner set in the outline of the paper, written only by wayline/outline.py through the ledger and journaled as `outline`; code builds the rest of research/OUTLINE.md at every render and the owner's settings always win. `groups` holds each part the owner ordered, every line in it in the owner's order (a line is R3, O2, or <section>:<heading>); the parts are `objectives` (the order of the Results subsections), `introduction`, `discussion`, `methods`, `results:O<n>` (an objective's subsection), `results:beyond`, `results:inherited`, `supplement`, and `cut`. `notes` are the owner's notes by line, `added` the headings the owner added (a Results one is a new question, offered as an objective), and `gone` the placements whose item went since, each listed once until the owner's next change.

groups.description: part -> the lines the owner ordered there, in order; a line that arrives later goes after them, marked new

notes.description: line -> the owner's note under it, an instruction; it follows a merged result and a reframed objective

added.description: the headings the owner added, which the writer fills at the order; one in Results is offered as an objective

gone.description: placements whose item is gone (merged, withdrawn, its objective dropped), dropped by code and listed once
